ModMetaData.name: Gravship Compat (local patches)
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Local content + compatibility patches for the "crashed Factory ship / Jawa stowaways" gravship campaign. Self-authored, kept minimal and defensive. Each PATCH is wrapped in PatchOperationConditional so a missing target (mod not loaded, def renamed in an update) is a silent no-op instead of a red error. LOAD THIS LAST in the mod order (RimSort), after every mod it touches.
Currently contains: - Defs/WeatherDefs/SWDesertWeather.xml — four hazard weathers (sandstorm, dry sandstorm, red fog, red foggy rain) extracted from "Star Wars - Biomes Addon" (Ferreira312, WS 2298926362). Pure XML, no assembly: the mod's custom C# overlay classes were swapped for the vanilla fog overlay while keeping all gameplay fields (accuracy/move/wind/lightning). Sandstorm cuts ranged accuracy to 0.25; dry sandstorm adds lightning-started fires; red fog / foggy rain reduce accuracy (and, for the rain, move speed). - Patches/AnimalBiomeDuplicates_Fix.xml — removes 3 duplicate (biome, animal) registrations that crash BiomeDef.CommonalityOfAnimal(). Armadillo x AridShrubland and Armadillo x Desert (Beasts of the Rim's animal-side wildBiomes duplicating Odyssey's biome-side wildAnimals), and Titan x TropicalSwamp (the Titans mod lists the biome twice in its own def). Left unfixed these kill Choose Wild Animal Spawns outright, make Giddy-Up skip its animal-biome cache, and abort Biome Compatibility Project inside RimWorld's post-load queue. Detected by Utils/animal_inventory.py; re-run it after mod updates. Nothing is lost in-game — the biome-side registration still spawns the animal. - Patches/SWDesertWeather_Attach.xml — injects those weathers into hot/arid biomes (sandstorms) and volcanic/exotic biomes (red fog) via baseWeatherCommonalities. Conditional-wrapped per biome. Tune the commonality numbers there to taste.
